answer: Seed each epoch with a few canary questions that have a subtle trap, like asking how many jade tiles fill a spiral that is quietly impossible. Honest, independent agents fail in scattered ways, but fifty seats run by one operator share a model and prompt, so they fall into the same canyon with the same wrong reasoning. Any identities whose trap mistakes match far beyond chance are merged into one account that earns one reward and casts one vote. Cloning then buys nothing, and dodging it means paying for truly different minds.
